therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Inhibition of FLT3-ITD driven leukemic cell proliferation and survival
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with newly diagnosed FLT3-ITD positive acute myeloid leukemia

results.target_engagement_evidence: Population PK analysis showed dose-dependent drug exposure with geometric mean AUCss ranging from 2680 ng/mL in induction to 10200 ng/mL in continuation
biomarker_changes: FLT3-ITD minimal residual disease negativity achieved in 54 quizartinib vs 51 placebo patients with CR
Composite CR with FLT3-ITD MRD negativity in 66 quizartinib vs 58 placebo patients
safety_signals: QT prolongation (36 quizartinib vs 11 placebo patients)
results.dose_information: Dose escalation during continuation phase with two dose levels, administered with standard chemotherapy during induction and consolidation

context.comparator: Placebo plus standard of care chemotherapy
